implementation_statement: Office laptops and desktops lock after 10 minutes. Gaps: tablets have no enforced lock; the HMI never locks (operators need a constant view in season; compensating control planned: locked pump house plus named accounts).

Office Wi-Fi uses WPA2 with a pre-shared key; the packing shed access point bridges to the same network as the pump house. LoRaWAN field sensors use the vendor's network keys. Planned: separate packing shed and guest Wi-Fi from OT.
